covers.prediction: Africa's new century had brought more disaster than hope
covers.what_happened: Africa grew strongly all decade. The magazine reversed itself with "Africa rising" in 2011.

covers.prediction: One day had changed America, and with it the world (a reaction, not a forecast)
covers.what_happened: Wars in Afghanistan and Iraq followed, and security rules changed worldwide.

covers.prediction: The world had not done enough after September 11
covers.what_happened: America invaded Iraq within six months. The war on terror ran for 20 years.

covers.prediction: Terror is now global. Prepare for more attacks
covers.what_happened: Big attacks followed in Madrid (2004), London (2005) and Mumbai (2008).

covers.cover: The charming outcome of the Cancún trade talks
covers.prediction: World trade talks had failed in insult and deadlock (a comment on the news)
covers.what_happened: The Doha round of talks was never finished.

covers.prediction: The US defence secretary had to resign over the Abu Ghraib scandal
covers.what_happened: He kept his job for two and a half more years, resigning in November 2006.

covers.prediction: Pollution and health problems could slow China's rise
covers.what_happened: China kept rising and became the number two economy, but dirty air became a national crisis.

covers.prediction: The magazine backed Kerry over Bush, with a heavy heart
covers.what_happened: Bush won the 2004 election and stayed president until 2009.

covers.prediction: The world housing bubble, the biggest in history, would pop
covers.what_happened: US house prices fell by about a third and helped cause the 2008 financial crisis.

covers.prediction: Oil prices could go higher while America and China stayed addicted to oil
covers.what_happened: Oil hit 147 dollars a barrel in 2008. Both stayed the top oil users for years.

covers.prediction: Climate uncertainty is a reason to act now, and America should lead
covers.what_happened: The world kept warming. America's climate leadership came and went.

covers.prediction: Central banks had fed the boom, and the bust would be serious
covers.what_happened: The crunch became the worst financial crisis since the 1930s.

covers.prediction: Big dangers lurked under the calm surface of the US economy
covers.what_happened: The Great Recession began weeks later, officially dated from December 2007.

covers.prediction: America's slowdown would hurt the whole world, not just America
covers.what_happened: The US recession became the global financial crisis of 2008 and 2009.

covers.prediction: The financial system stood on the edge of disaster
covers.what_happened: The Great Recession followed, the worst downturn since the 1930s.

covers.prediction: A new flu could spread around the world as a pandemic
covers.what_happened: Swine flu was declared a pandemic but stayed mild. The huge pandemic came in 2020.

covers.cover: Debt: the biggest bill in history
covers.prediction: Crisis debt would land on children and grandchildren
covers.what_happened: Rich world government debt kept climbing for 15 more years.

covers.prediction: Brazil's moment as a serious world power had arrived
covers.what_happened: A fast boom, then a deep recession in 2015 and 2016 and a giant corruption scandal.

covers.prediction: Greece's debt crisis could spread across Europe and threaten the euro
covers.what_happened: It spread to Ireland, Portugal, Spain, Italy and Cyprus. Greece shrank by about a quarter.

covers.prediction: Change was coming to Egypt. Mubarak's grip was weaker than it looked
covers.what_happened: The Arab Spring swept Mubarak from power six months later.

covers.cover: Just as the world economy was recovering
covers.prediction: Trouble in the oil region could kill the young world recovery
covers.what_happened: Oil stayed costly and Europe hurt, but world growth still reached about 4 percent.

covers.cover: The man who screwed an entire country
covers.prediction: Berlusconi's years in power had badly damaged Italy (a judgment)
covers.what_happened: He was forced to resign five months later. Italy's economy stayed weak for years.

covers.prediction: The Berlusconi era was finally over
covers.what_happened: He resigned the same week and never became prime minister again.

covers.prediction: Scottish independence would come at a high price
covers.what_happened: Scotland voted No in 2014. The oil income in the Yes plans then collapsed.

covers.prediction: Hollande's plans were dangerous for France and for the euro
covers.what_happened: He softened his most radical plans and ended unpopular. The euro survived.

covers.prediction: Germany might tire of paying and let the euro break up
covers.what_happened: Draghi promised "whatever it takes". The euro survived and no country has left it.

covers.cover: The time-bomb at the heart of Europe
covers.prediction: France, not Greece or Spain, was the euro's biggest danger
covers.what_happened: Markets never attacked France. French borrowing costs stayed low.

covers.prediction: Not yet. Change would be a long process
covers.what_happened: Egypt returned to military rule, and Syria, Libya and Yemen fell into long wars.

covers.prediction: Brazil had wasted its boom years
covers.what_happened: Worst recession on record, the Petrobras scandal, and a president removed in 2016.

covers.prediction: An explosion of startups would reshape whole industries
covers.what_happened: Platforms transformed transport, hotels, shops, media, money and work.

covers.prediction: The magazine urged Scots to vote No to independence (an argument)
covers.what_happened: Scotland voted No by 55 percent to 45 percent. The union survived.

covers.prediction: The economics of oil had changed for good
covers.what_happened: Oil fell below 30 dollars. Shale survived and America became the top producer.

covers.prediction: China's economy was in deep trouble and fear could spread worldwide
covers.what_happened: Markets fell into early 2016, but there was no crash. China kept growing.

covers.prediction: Only Merkel had the strength to lead Europe (a judgment)
covers.what_happened: She led Germany until 2021, through Brexit and the Trump years.

covers.prediction: Brexit meant chaos, with nobody in control
covers.what_happened: No anarchy, but years of political chaos followed. Britain left the EU in 2020.

covers.prediction: The world's big powers were all turning nationalist at once
covers.what_happened: Travel bans, tariffs, a trade war with China and America First politics followed.

covers.prediction: Could one young leader rescue Europe and fix France?
covers.what_happened: Macron became Europe's leading voice, but faced the huge Yellow Vest protests.

covers.prediction: America and North Korea could blunder into nuclear war
covers.what_happened: No war. Trump and Kim met three times and the threats calmed down.

covers.cover: How to tame the tech titans
covers.prediction: Governments should rein in the giant tech firms
covers.what_happened: GDPR, billion dollar fines and big court cases followed, but no firm was broken up.

covers.prediction: A recession was coming and rich countries were badly prepared
covers.what_happened: A recession came in 2020, but from a virus, not from the causes the cover listed.

covers.prediction: The golden age of fast globalisation was over
covers.what_happened: Trade stayed flat, and production moved closer to home after COVID.

covers.prediction: Socialism was back in fashion among the young
covers.what_happened: The ideas stayed strong, but Sanders lost and Corbyn lost heavily in 2019.

covers.cover: The rule of law in Hong Kong
covers.prediction: A new law would destroy Hong Kong's rule of law
covers.what_happened: Beijing imposed the National Security Law in 2020. Old freedoms are judged gone.

covers.prediction: The revolt was about Hong Kong's whole future under China (a report)
covers.what_happened: The protests faded in 2020 and the National Security Law ended free politics.

covers.prediction: The Wuhan virus could become a pandemic
covers.what_happened: The WHO declared the COVID-19 pandemic weeks later.

covers.prediction: The crisis would make government much bigger, and some power would stay
covers.what_happened: States spent trillions and controlled daily life, then gave up most controls.

covers.prediction: Economies would run at about 90 percent of normal for a long time
covers.what_happened: It fitted 2020 and 2021, but vaccines and spending brought a stronger bounce.

covers.cover: The next catastrophe (and how to survive it)
covers.prediction: The world should prepare properly for the next big disaster
covers.what_happened: More shocks came, and experts still say preparedness is weak.

covers.prediction: Biden faced a giant clean-up job in a divided country
covers.what_happened: Vaccines and a strong recovery came fast. Division and high inflation followed.

covers.prediction: 2021 would be a gamble on vaccines, unity and climate action
covers.what_happened: Vaccines rolled out, but Delta and Omicron waves and the Capitol attack came too.

covers.prediction: No words and no forecast. A statement of horror and support
covers.what_happened: The war went on for years, with Ukraine still fighting, backed by the West.

covers.prediction: Russia and China were building an alternative world order
covers.what_happened: Record trade and joint exercises followed, but no single formal bloc.

covers.prediction: The war could push the world into a huge food crisis
covers.what_happened: Food prices hit record highs and hunger rose, but the worst famine was avoided.

covers.cover: The AI angel and devil cover
covers.prediction: AI would be both an angel of progress and a devil of danger
covers.what_happened: Real gains and real fears grew side by side, and the debate still runs in 2026.

covers.prediction: War, US-China rivalry and inflation would dominate 2023
covers.what_happened: All three did. The explosion of AI was the bigger surprise.

covers.prediction: Democracy was on the ballot in the biggest election year in history
covers.what_happened: More than 60 countries voted. Trump won the US presidency.

covers.prediction: America's economy was the strongest in the rich world
covers.what_happened: US growth beat every other big rich economy in 2024.

covers.prediction: One man, Trump, would dominate world politics in 2025
covers.what_happened: Sweeping tariffs, clashes with allies and daily headlines all year.

covers.prediction: Trump's tariffs would cause economic havoc in America and the world
covers.what_happened: Markets plunged fast, then he paused many tariffs. No global recession followed.

covers.prediction: A year of celebration on the surface and deep danger underneath
covers.what_happened: America's 250th birthday and the World Cup happened. Wars and the AI race ran on.

covers.prediction: A portrait of Nvidia's boss at the very top of the AI boom (not a forecast)
covers.what_happened: Nvidia's shares fell about 29 percent in the following weeks.

covers.prediction: Can AI firms ever earn back the huge money poured into them?
covers.what_happened: PENDING. The issue is days old. The question is still open.
